rows.grounds: reduplicated adverb indicating repeated upward progression
ablative used adverbially to indicate mode of mental visualization

items.question: In what manner must the seat be worshipped through successive contemplation?
premises: The seat is established as the object of worship.
The act of worship is expressed as a completed prior action.
The worship is to be performed repeatedly in an ascending manner.
Contemplation provides the mode for this repeated worship.
items.inference: Therefore the seat must be worshipped again and again in successive stages through contemplative visualization.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of bhāvataḥ as contemplative mode versus arising from meditation is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And having worshipped the seat, one should worship it again and again, successively above, through contemplation.
